platforms.releaseNotes: Prepared candidate platform release for update verification.

config.hint: Studio access: "secured" requires login; "local" is a no-login install that binds loopback only
Email of the first administrator (secured access)
Tenant that owns the first administrator; leave unset to use GATEWAY_BOOTSTRAP_TENANT_ID or the gateway default (kblabs-cloud)
Password of the first administrator; kb-create generates one when omitted and discloses it once after successful install
HMAC secret that signs session tokens (e.g. `openssl rand -hex 64`); without it the gateway uses a public development secret
Shared gateway-to-service authentication secret; kb-create generates and preserves it
Persistent database file for secured gateway identity, session, invite, and reset data
Set OPENAI_API_KEY or run kb config set platform.adapterOptions.llm.apiKey '${OPENAI_API_KEY}' --allow-missing-env
config.action: set OPENAI_API_KEY to enable LLM features
